# AI Support Agent & RAG Knowledge Base

> **Commercial Reference:** Malt Mission - *"Intégration Agent Chatbot IA RAG & Support Client"*
> **Target Market Pricing:** 4,500€ - 8,000€ per project / TJM: 600€ - 800€

## Overview
Enterprise customer support agent simulator powered by RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Features document ingestion, semantic similarity search, and system prompt customization.

## Features
- Ingestion and tokenization of customer FAQ documents
- Lightning-fast client-side RAG vector-style similarity matcher
- Custom system prompt tuner (tone, guardrails, fallback rules)
- Interactive widget preview testbench
